name: lexus_1lr_gue
label: Lexus LFA 4.8 L V10 (1LR-GUE, even-firing 72°)

sources.what: Toyota-hosted 2011 Lexus LFA owner's manual (US). Manufacturer document; has the engine specification table.
Toyota global press release of 21 Oct 2009 announcing the LFA (archived). Manufacturer; power, torque, intake and exhaust description.
Motor Fan (Japanese technical magazine) article on the 1LR-GUE crankshaft with dimensions and the shared-pin layout.
Motor Fan engine profile of the 1LR-GUE; states the bank angle was chosen for even firing; spec table.
australiancar.reviews engine article; secondary summary of Lexus technical material (valvetrain, intake, exhaust).
Japanese Wikipedia article on the LR engine; more mechanical detail than the English page, but unreferenced in places.
English Wikipedia Toyota LR engine page; used only for the 9,500 rpm fuel cut and the 6,800 rpm torque figure.
km77 (Spanish car magazine) technical description of the LFA; exhaust valve behaviour.

notes: Sourced: bore, stroke, compression, 72-degree bank with five shared crank pins and even 72-degree firing, four valves per cylinder, ten individual throttles, equal-length exhaust manifolds into a dual exhaust, 9000 rpm maximum. The firing ORDER and cylinder numbering were not found: the order used (1-6-5-10-2-7-3-8-4-9, cylinders 1-5 on one bank) is assumed; any order that fires evenly with shared pins gives the same pulse spacing, and with equal-length pipes the choice does not change the modelled sound. Estimated, not sourced: rod length, valve diameters and lifts, cam timing and duration (dual variable timing on the real engine; one fixed timing is used), intake tract length and diameter, exhaust primary and pipe sizes, the cross-over between banks, idle speed. The surge tank the real throttles breathe from is not modelled: individual throttles open to the air here. Left to the simulator's defaults: collector volume, muffler, flywheel inertia. Also estimates: friction_scale, heat_q, burn_scale (the simulator's friction, heat-release and burn-rate scales), set with the other estimated fields so that simulated torque and power come near the published figures; no sourced number was changed.

vehicle.name: Lexus LFA (2011)
vehicle.notes: Six-speed ASG robotised transaxle. All figures from Lexus's 2011 owner's manual. The final drive is the product of the published front counter gear (1.259) and differential (3.417); the multiplication is ours, and it reproduces the manual's maximum speeds in each gear. Estimated: rolling radius from the tyre size.
